task.question: How many people were killed in the earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026?
task.evidence: August 15 – At least 129 people are killed and nearly 1,300 injured when a magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes off the island of Flores, Indonesia.

answer: The earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026, killed at least 142 people. FINAL: 142 fatalities

The earthquake was caused by movement on the Flores back-arc thrust fault located north of the island. Seismic observatories recorded a maximum Modified Mercalli intensity of VIII (Severe) on Flores.
